visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a bright, modern kitchen with a light-colored countertop. A hand is seen pouring water from a floral-patterned pitcher into a stainless steel container holding dried mushrooms and then pouring liquid from a dark bottle into a small white bowl containing dried shrimp. (2) A person’s hands peel outer leaves from a large Napa cabbage, cut the base with a kitchen knife on a wooden board, and then wash the leaves under a faucet. The cabbage is then meticulously sliced into smaller pieces, separating the stalks from the leaves, which are placed into separate stainless steel and yellow containers. (3) A tray of raw shrimp and large scallops is shown. The camera then cuts to a woman with short dark hair wearing a white shirt and a pink apron; she is standing in a brightly lit kitchen and opens the lid of a bright blue Dutch oven. (4) In a series of close-up shots, the woman’s hands squeeze water from the soaked mushrooms, slice them into thin strips, squeeze the dried shrimp, and crush garlic cloves using a metal pitcher. (5) In the blue pot on a stovetop, oil is heated, and dried fish strips are sautéed until golden brown and then removed. Dried shrimp, mushroom strips, and garlic are then added to the remaining oil and stirred with a wooden spatula. (6) Cabbage stalks are added to the pot and sautéed, followed by the addition of soy sauce, wine, and cabbage leaves. The mixture is stirred as it softens. Soaking liquid is poured in, the fried fish is crumbled back into the pot, and the lid is closed for simmering. (7) After opening the lid, the scallops and shrimp are added to the simmering cabbage mixture. Starch slurry is poured in to thicken the sauce, and the dish is stirred until it reaches a thick, glossy consistency. (8) The woman is shown sitting at a table, taking a bite of the finished dish served over rice. She looks at the camera with a satisfied expression, clearly enjoying the meal. Text overlays appear at the bottom.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 乾香菇先泡溫水. (2) [Subtitle]: 蝦米泡一下紹興酒. (3) [Subtitle]: 先把外層的葉子摘下來. (4) [Subtitle]: 再帶蒂的地方切掉. (5) [Subtitle]: 接著再拿去洗乾淨. (6) [Subtitle]: 從梗跟葉子的地方切段. (7) [Subtitle]: 梗的部分切小塊. (8) [Subtitle]: 這樣會比較軟，好入口. (9) [Subtitle]: 葉子部分隨意切即可. (10) [Subtitle]: 把梗跟葉子分開放. (11) [Subtitle]: 準備一些干貝跟蝦仁，先退冰. (12) [Subtitle]: 接著來煮一鍋飯❤️. (13) [Subtitle]: 香菇擠乾水分. (14) [Subtitle]: 切成絲. (15) [Subtitle]: 蝦米擦乾水分備用. (16) [Subtitle]: 擦乾爆香才不會噴油. (17) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭拍裂開來，去掉皮. (18) [Subtitle]: 建議可以準備一些扁魚，味道會更好！. (19) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡放入多一點的油，開中火加熱. (20) [Subtitle]: 把扁魚放進來. (21) [Subtitle]: 慢慢的把扁魚煸到酥酥香香的. (22) [Subtitle]: 煸好之後，先夾起來備用. (23) [Subtitle]: 油先降溫一下，再放入蝦米跟香菇爆香～. (24) [Subtitle]: 把蒜頭也放進來. (25) [Subtitle]: 慢慢的煸出香氣. (26) [Subtitle]: 一點胡椒調味. (27) [Subtitle]: 大概煸到香菇表面產生焦香色. (28) [Subtitle]: 放入白菜梗. (29) [Subtitle]: 跟鍋裡的料拌炒均勻. (30) [Subtitle]: 炒到白菜軟化，體積縮小些... (31) [Subtitle]: 鍋底嗆入紹興酒跟醬油、蠔油. (32) [Subtitle]: 繼續炒出香味. (33) [Subtitle]: 接著把白菜葉放進來. (34) [Subtitle]: 拌炒一下，讓體積縮小. (35) [Subtitle]: 再放入剩下的白菜. (36) [Subtitle]: 繼續的炒軟. (37) [Subtitle]: 都軟化些後... (38) [Subtitle]: 加入100ml的熱水跟香菇水. (39) [Subtitle]: 拌勻... (40) [Subtitle]: 稍微煮滾... (41) [Subtitle]: 把剛才的扁魚捏碎，放入湯裡燉... (42) [Subtitle]: 轉小火，蓋上鍋蓋，燉煮15~20分鐘. (43) [Subtitle]: 好囉～開蓋～哇！！好香的味道❤️. (44) [Subtitle]: 白菜的湯汁都滲透出來了～. (45) [Subtitle]: 海鮮也退冰了～. (46) [Subtitle]: 準備一些太白粉水勾芡. (47) [Subtitle]: 把蝦仁跟干貝放進來. (48) [Subtitle]: 拌一下，讓海鮮的風味溶入湯裡. (49) [Subtitle]: 最後加上太白粉水勾芡，快速的攪拌均勻. (50) [Subtitle]: 煮滾後確認一下稠度. (51) [Subtitle]: 喜歡再稠一點，可以再勾芡一次. (52) [Subtitle]: 像這樣～超級好吃的『干貝海鮮白菜滷』就完成啦～❤️. (53) [Subtitle]: 干貝不要煮太熟，這樣會很嫩很好吃喔！❤️. (54) [Subtitle]: 哇～這道簡單的白菜滷湯好鮮❤️. (55) [Subtitle]: 白菜好軟，好喜歡❤️. (56) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理，請追蹤我 IG. [Subtitle]: 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房. [Logo]: YouTube:@RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, medium-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a soft shaker rhythm. A crisp liquid pouring sound is heard twice. (2) A sharp percussive 'thwack' occurs as cabbage is cut, followed by a rapid series of rhythmic 'tok-tok-tok' chopping sounds. (3) A distinct metallic clink of a lid being lifted is heard. (4) A splashing and squeezing sound of water occurs, followed by more rhythmic chopping. A dull thud marks the crushing of garlic. (5) A high-pitched, sustained 'shhh' sizzling sound begins as oil heats and food is added to a pan, occasionally interrupted by the scraping of a wooden utensil against metal. (6) A metallic 'clack' signifies the lid closing, while the background music maintains its upbeat, major-mode progression. (7) Bubbling and simmering liquid sounds are prominent, layered with metallic scraping as ingredients are stirred. (8) A final crisp crunching and slurping sound is heard as someone takes a bite of food, with the music swelling slightly before fading out.
